fields.why: PRMRs and cause-specific proportions are compared across five race/ethnicity groups, and PRMRs are shown across six age groups and four education levels.
Race/ethnicity (5 groups), age (6) and education as SES (4) each have per-group outcomes in Table 1; state tertiles and period are not SPDs.

Race contrasts are disparity ratios vs white, and the Table 2 chi-square marks are each group vs white, so per-group vs referent only; PRMR by age and by education is shown or ranked with no test. The mechanical flag is a false hit: the chi-square concerns race, not the age or education entries.

brief_issues: The methods say only 'differences by race/ethnicity were identified using chi-squared tests' over 10 causes x 5 groups; read alone that could be an omnibus test (rule 2), but the Table 2 notes fix the referent at white, which decides per-group vs referent.
